heroCopy: Every song is a prayer that your heart will be pointed to Jesus Christ.
storyTitle: Sometimes God’s answer to discouragement is another song.
storyLead: Some songs are born out of celebration. Others come through disappointment, unanswered prayers, and quiet moments when God whispers, “Keep going.”
storyBody: After a deeply discouraging response to one of his songs, Billy seriously considered laying songwriting aside. Instead, God began filling his heart with new melodies—reminders that the calling had not changed.
musicTitle: Hope for the road you’re walking.
quote: God’s faithfulness is greater than life’s greatest storms.
ministryBody: Based in Mississippi, Billy partners with churches and Christian organizations for gatherings centered on worship, God’s Word, and His faithfulness.
aboutBody: For decades, God has allowed Billy to serve people through pastoral ministry, Christian counseling, writing, and music—all with one purpose: helping people discover God’s faithfulness in every season of life.
newsletterTitle: A little encouragement for the journey.
newsletterBody: Receive occasional devotionals, behind-the-song stories, ministry updates, and new music announcements.
